html:
Reggaeton is a music that took shape in Puerto Rico in the 1990s, mixing Jamaican dancehall, hip hop and Latin rhythms, sung or rapped in Spanish over the dembow beat. Its roots also include Spanish language reggae from Panama.

It grew in the poor housing projects of San Juan, where police raided shops selling the underground tapes for their lyrics. Daddy Yankee's Gasolina (2004) made it an international hit.

In the 2010s artists such as Bad Bunny made it the most streamed music in the world for a time, and Despacito (2017) became one of the most watched videos online. It carries the Jamaican beat of the Caribbean to a global audience.
sum: Reggaeton is a music that took shape in Puerto Rico in the 1990s, mixing Jamaican dancehall, hip hop and Latin rhythms, sung or rapped in Spanish over the dembow beat. Its roots also include Spanish language reggae from Panama.
